sloka: संगृह्य पादौ पितुः उग्रतेजाजग्राह मातुः पुनर् एव पादौ ।पादौ रुमायाः च निपीडयित्वानिवेदयामास ततः तत् अर्थम् ॥४-३१-३७॥
transliteration: saṁgṛhya pādau pituḥ ugratejājagrāha mātuḥ punar eva pādau ।pādau rumāyāḥ ca nipīḍayitvānivedayāmāsa tataḥ tat artham ॥4-31-37॥

translations.english: Highly brilliant Angada holding his father's feet first, then mother's and thereafter Ruma's, reported the matter to Sugriva.
